answer: An identity must be at least 4 epochs old on the lotus ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Because the age is read from the atlas checkpoint rather than self-declared, the dawn audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm hence means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
